description: provenance_mode.time_rung='notarized' is outside the closed {self_attested, witnessed} enum on an otherwise well-formed backfilled record -> a single provenance_mode_invalid (check 9, gating); the unrecognized value is reset (time_rung=None) so it is NOT also treated as a witnessed overclaim, and derived.provenance_time_rung stays 'self_attested'.

findings.detail: provenance_mode.time_rung MUST be one of ['self_attested', 'witnessed'] (§5.3(bis) Provenance mode); got 'notarized'
